blocks.prompt: 3 A radioactive substance decays as \(N = 800e^{-0.05t}\), where \(t\) is in hours. Find the time when the amount reduces to 200.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh decay ka sawal hai: radioactive maadda \(N = 800e^{-0.05t}\) ke mutabiq ghat raha hai. Power mein minus sign batata hai ke \(k = -0.05\) negative hai, yani decay.
Diya kya hai? Shuru mein 800, aur aakhir mein miqdaar 200 reh jati hai.
Find kya karna hai? Waqt \(t\), jo power mein hai.
Rule kaunsa? Exponential ko akela karna, phir \(\ln\) lena. Saath mein \(\ln\frac{1}{4} = -\ln 4\) wala rule bhi kaam aayega.
Plan: 200 rakhna, 800 se divide, \(\ln\) lena, aur \(-0.05\) se divide karna.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(N = 800e^{-0.05t}\) aur \(N = 200\).
Maloom karna: waqt \(t\) (ghanton mein).
Tareeqa: \(e^{-0.05t}\) ko akela kar ke \(\ln\) lenge, taa ke \(t\) power se neeche aa jaye.

\(N = 200\) rakhein
\[200 = 800e^{-0.05t}\]
Kyun: jis lamhe miqdaar 200 hai, us lamhe bhi model sahi hai.

Exponential ko akela karein
\[\dfrac{200}{800} = e^{-0.05t}\]
\[\dfrac{1}{4} = e^{-0.05t}\]
Kyun: dono taraf 800 se divide kiya aur fraction ko 200 se chhota kiya.

Dono taraf \(\ln\) lein
\[\ln\left(\dfrac{1}{4}\right) = -0.05t\]
\[-\ln 4 = -0.05t\]
Kyun: \(\ln(e^{-0.05t}) = -0.05t\). Aur \(\ln\frac{1}{4} = \ln 1 - \ln 4\), jahan \(\ln 1 = 0\), to yeh \(-\ln 4\) bana.
Dhyan dein: \(\ln\frac{1}{4}\) negative hai (taqreeban \(-1.3863\)). Is minus ko gira diya to waqt negative aa jayega, jo mumkin nahi.

\(t\) nikaalein
\[t = \dfrac{\ln 4}{0.05}\]
\[= \dfrac{1.386294}{0.05}\]
\[\approx 27.73\]
Kyun: dono taraf \(-0.05\) se divide kiya. Dono taraf minus tha, is liye minus minus cancel ho gaye aur waqt positive aaya.

Tasdeeq
\[800e^{-0.05 \times 27.73} = 800e^{-1.3865}\]
\[\approx 800 \times 0.25 = 200 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: jawab rakhne se 200 mila. Ek mazedar tareeqe se bhi dekhiye: 800 se 400, phir 400 se 200, yani do dafa aadha hua. Half-life \(\frac{\ln 2}{0.05} \approx 13.86\) ghante hai, aur \(2 \times 13.86 = 27.73\). Wohi jawab!
